metadata.title: Hosea
metadata.subtitle: Hosea 1:1 – 14:9 (43 questions)
metadata.description: Questions on the Book of Hosea according to the King James Version (1769).
metadata.author: King James Version (1769)

questions.text: What command did the LORD give unto Hosea at the beginning (Hosea 1:2)?

options.text: To offer a sacrifice in the holy temple at Jerusalem for the sins of people
Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms, for the land hath departed from God
To build an altar on Mount Carmel and call upon the prophets of strange gods
To proclaim war against the king of Assyria and muster all the tribes of land

questions.text: What does the name Lo-ruhamah signify in Hosea 1:6?

options.text: I will be your God and show great mercy unto you for ever
I will bless you abundantly and never chastise your house
I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel
I will bring you up out of Egypt and make you a great nation

questions.text: What name was given to Hosea's third child and what does it mean (Hosea 1:8-9)?

options.text: Immanuel: God with us, for the LORD will never leave His children
Lo-ruhamah: I will no more have mercy upon the rebellious people
Jezreel: God soweth, for the LORD will scatter His chosen seed
Lo-ammi: Call his name Lo-ammi, for ye are not my people

questions.text: What promise follows the word Lo-ammi in Hosea 1:10?

options.text: Where it was said: Ye are not my people, there it shall be said: Sons of God
The children of Israel shall be scattered among all nations and humiliated
The princes of Israel shall serve the king of Asshur and pay yearly tribute
The people shall pay the sacred tithe and be blessed in the fertile land

questions.text: What ignorance of Israel is rebuked in Hosea 2:8?

options.text: She would not keep the commandments of the covenant made at Sinai
She did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil
She refused to bring the firstfruits of her harvest to the altar
She forgot the ancient songs of praise that David composed

questions.text: How will the LORD win back His unfaithful bride in Hosea 2:14?

options.text: He will send fierce judgment and famine to break her stony heart
He will command the priests to sanctify her with oil in the temple
I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak kindly
He will cause all the nations round about to mock her in her misery

questions.text: What shall Israel call the LORD in that day according to Hosea 2:16?

options.text: Thou shalt call me my Master, and no more my Friend
Thou shalt call me my King, and no more my Shepherd
Thou shalt call me my Judge, and no more my Lawgiver
Thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali

questions.text: For what price did Hosea buy back his wife in Hosea 3:2?

options.text: For fifteen pieces of silver, and an homer and half homer of barley
For thirty pieces of silver, and two full homers of choice wheat
For fifty pieces of silver, and three full homers of pure spelt
For ten pieces of silver, and an half homer of unthreshed wheat

questions.text: What condition is foretold for the children of Israel in Hosea 3:4?

options.text: They shall dwell as captives in Egypt and serve strange gods day and night
Israel shall abide many days without king, prince, sacrifice, image, ephod
They shall be ruled by a foreign prince who will take away all their cattle
They shall wander in the desert forty years until that generation perish

questions.text: Whom shall the children of Israel seek in the latter days (Hosea 3:5)?

options.text: The wise prophets of old and the high priest of the sanctuary
The ancient laws of Moses and the sacred covenant of their fathers
The LORD their God, and David their king, in fear and trembling
The lost inheritance of their tribes in the holy mountain of Zion

questions.text: What does the LORD find lacking in the land according to Hosea 4:1?

options.text: Silver, gold, and costly garments among the princes of the realm
Sacrifices, tithes, and incense on the high places of the hills
Fortified cities and valiant warriors to defend the borders
No truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land

questions.text: Why are the priests rejected by the LORD in Hosea 4:6?

options.text: Because thou hast rejected knowledge and forgotten the law of God
Because they offered blind and lame beasts upon the holy altar
Because they took gifts of gold from the heathen kings around them
Because they refused to wear the consecrated garments of linen

questions.text: What caused the people to err according to Hosea 4:12?

options.text: The cunning words of the foreign merchant princes from Tyre
The spirit of whoredoms caused them to err from their God
The heavy burdens laid upon them by the ungodly taxgatherers
The fear of the armies of Assyria that invaded their cities

questions.text: What happens when they go with flocks and herds to seek the LORD (Hosea 5:6)?

options.text: Their sacrifices are accepted with great joy upon the altar
The fire of heaven consumes their offerings in the sight of all
They shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them
The priests rejoice and proclaim a solemn feast throughout land

questions.text: Unto whom did Ephraim send when he saw his sickness (Hosea 5:13)?

options.text: Unto the wise physicians of Egypt that dwelt by the Nile
Unto the priests of Bethel to inquire of the golden calves
Unto the prophets of Jerusalem to pray for healing and peace
Unto the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal

questions.text: Until when will the LORD return unto His place in Hosea 5:15?

options.text: Till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face in affliction
Till all their cities be overthrown and the land become wilderness
Till seventy years of captivity be accomplished in foreign realm
Till a righteous king of the house of David reign in Jerusalem

questions.text: What confidence is expressed in the call to repentance in Hosea 6:1-2?

options.text: The LORD will destroy all our enemies and exalt our royal throne
He hath torn, and he will heal; in the third day he will raise us up
Our righteousness shall shine as the sun and all nations praise us
The famine shall cease immediately and sweet wine flow in abundance

questions.text: Unto what is the goodness of Ephraim and Judah likened in Hosea 6:4?

options.text: Unto an oak tree whose leaves wither before the winter cold
Unto a broken cistern that can hold no water for the thirsty
As a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away
Unto a fading flower that falls to the earth in the drought

questions.text: What does the LORD desire according to Hosea 6:6?

options.text: Costly burnt offerings of thousands of rams upon the altar
Splendid sanctuaries of cedar and gold throughout the borders
Fasting and weeping in sackcloth before the eyes of princes
For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; knowledge of God

questions.text: Unto what is Ephraim likened in Hosea 7:8?

options.text: A cake not turned, mixing himself among the people
A dry leaf blown about by every wind in the desert
An unfaithful servant who squanders his master's goods
A wild ass of the wilderness that snuffeth up the wind

questions.text: Unto what is Ephraim likened in Hosea 7:11?

options.text: Unto an eagle that soareth high above the mountain tops
Like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, go to Assyria
Unto a roaring lion seeking prey in the forests of Lebanon
Unto a swift deer that fleeth before the huntsmen in fields

questions.text: Unto what is the turning of the people compared in Hosea 7:16?

options.text: Unto an unfaithful messenger that runneth into the desert
Unto a broken jar that can hold no wine for the feast
They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow
Unto a shadow that declineth and leaveth only cold darkness

questions.text: What proverb concerning judgment is declared in Hosea 8:7?

options.text: He that diggeth a pit shall fall headlong into the same
He that soweth righteousness shall reap life everlasting
The fathers have eaten sour grapes and the children suffer
For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind

questions.text: How is Israel described among the Gentiles in Hosea 8:8?

options.text: As a vessel wherein is no pleasure, swallowed up by foes
As a proud crown of gold that was cast down into dust
As a mighty host that fled without a battle before sword
As a noble vine whose pleasant branches were consumed

questions.text: How did Israel regard the great things of God's law (Hosea 8:12)?

options.text: As a joyful light and sure guide for their daily paths
As a strange thing, though I have written great things of law
As an heavy yoke that none of the fathers could endure
As an holy treasure to be kept secret from all Gentiles

questions.text: How did the LORD find Israel in ancient days according to Hosea 9:10?

options.text: As a blooming rose in the garden of royal delights
As an olive tree full of pleasant boughs upon mountain
I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness, as firstripe fig
As an eagle's young that hovered safely beneath wings

questions.text: What shall happen unto the glory of Ephraim in Hosea 9:11?

options.text: It shall be preserved in the heavenly books of memorial
It shall shine like the brightness of the sun at midday
It shall be sold unto foreign merchantmen for much gold
Their glory shall fly away like a bird, from birth and womb

questions.text: Unto what lot does the Lord GOD consign the people in Hosea 9:17?

options.text: They shall be wanderers among the nations, cast away by God
They shall be made tributary servants to the king of Asshur
They shall dwell safely in walled cities and see no famine
They shall perish in the desert and their name be forgotten

questions.text: How did Israel's altars multiply according to Hosea 10:1?

options.text: The more fruit it bare, the more sacrifices it gave unto God
According to the multitude of fruit it increased the altars
The less fruit it bare, the more altars of stone it built up
According to the wealth of the land it made fewer altars there

questions.text: What shall they say to the mountains and hills in Hosea 10:8?

options.text: Deliver us from the wrath of the foe, and hills: Guard us!
Give us water from thy rocks, and to the hills: Shelter us!
They shall say to mountains, Cover us; and to hills, Fall on us
Hear the lamentation of our souls, and to hills: Weep for us!

questions.text: What does the LORD command His people to do in Hosea 10:12?

options.text: Offer burnt offerings and fast seven days in sackcloth and ashes
Build fortified towers against the coming armies of Assyria
Bring the firstborn of your cattle unto the priests at Jerusalem
Sow in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground

questions.text: Which verse of Hosea is quoted in the Gospel of Matthew (Hosea 11:1)?

options.text: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, called my son from Egypt
Out of Bethlehem shall come forth a ruler over my people Israel
A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping for all
The virgin shall conceive and bear a son, called Immanuel by God

questions.text: How does Hosea 11:3 describe the loving care of the LORD for Ephraim?

options.text: He gave him silver and gold and made his kings mighty over realms
I taught Ephraim to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not
He fought their battles with a drawn sword and gave them the spoil
He built them high walled cities and kept off all foreign enemies

questions.text: What tender cry breaks from the heart of the LORD in Hosea 11:8?

options.text: I will utterly consume thee, Ephraim, and make an end of thy name
Thy iniquity is written with a pen of iron and cannot be pardoned
How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? mine heart is turned within me
Return unto me with weeping, or I will blot thee out of my book

questions.text: What event in Jacob's life is recalled in Hosea 12:4?

options.text: He fled from the face of Esau and slept on a stone in Bethel
He served Laban fourteen years for Rachel and kept his sheep
He blessed the two sons of Joseph with his hands crossed over
Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept and prayed

questions.text: What admonition is given in Hosea 12:6?

options.text: Turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, wait on God continually
Offer the daily sacrifice of morning and evening with holy reverence
Trust not in the princes of Asshur, nor seek help from royal Egypt
Prepare horses and chariots for battle, but pray with loud crying

questions.text: What boast does Ephraim make in Hosea 12:8?

options.text: Our armies have conquered the south, and no nation can withstand us
Yet I am become rich, found substance: they shall find none iniquity
The temple of God is in our midst, and we shall never be moved down
We have made peace with the kings of east, and none shall make afraid

questions.text: What does the LORD testify concerning Himself in Hosea 13:4?

options.text: I am the Creator of heaven and earth, who established the mountains
I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob throughout all generations
I am the LORD thy God from land of Egypt; no saviour beside me
I am a consuming fire that executeth fierce wrath on all the wicked

questions.text: What cry unto death and the grave is proclaimed in Hosea 13:14?

options.text: Where is thy victory, O grave? where is thy sting, O fierce death?
The grave shall consume all kings, and death swallow up all nations
I will make a covenant with death, that it touch not my chosen ones
O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction

questions.text: What effect did Israel's pasture and prosperity have (Hosea 13:6)?

options.text: They were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore forgot me
They built altars of thanksgiving and praised the name of the LORD
They shared their bread with the poor and cared for the fatherless
They remembered the ancient covenant and walked humbly before God

questions.text: What should the penitent take with them according to Hosea 14:2?

options.text: Costly burnt offerings of rams, as commanded in the holy law
Take with you words, and turn to LORD: so will we render calves of lips
Silver and gold to enrich the sanctuary and support holy priests
Firstfruits of the vintage to appease the anger of the Almighty

questions.text: What gracious promise does the LORD give in Hosea 14:4?

options.text: I will chastise them in measure until they seek my holy face
I will lead them into Babylon and speak comfortable words there
I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely and turn wrath
I will cause them to wait seven seasons until they cry for aid

questions.text: With what declaration does the Book of Hosea conclude (Hosea 14:9)?

options.text: The LORD shall come with ten thousands of saints to judge earth
The LORD is King for ever, and all the Gentiles shall serve Him
The remnant of Jacob shall possess the gate of their proud foes
The ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them
